meta.name: itr-wala
meta.description: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax, advance tax, or the income-tax e-filing portal - even if they just say "help me with my taxes" in an Indian context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 填报印度个税,核对退税与资本利得
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在印度工作或投资,需要申报个税
copy.tagline_en: File Indian income tax returns, track refunds and capital gains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work or invest in India and need to file personal income tax.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 带你完成 2025-26 财年印度所得税申报：收集 Form 16、AIS 等文件，转录并核对数据，用脚本计算税款、比较新旧税制，生成申报包并指导官网填写。所有计算由脚本完成，付款、提交、电子验证由你操作。
howto.when: 当你想申报或核对税款、比较新旧税制、查看 Form 16/AIS 等文件，或提到 ITR、资本利得、退税等关键词时触发；哪怕只说“帮我处理税务”也会启动。

say.text: 帮我申报 2025-26 财年的所得税。
say.note: Claude 会创建申报工作区并开始收集文件。

say.text: 比较一下新旧税制，哪个更省？
say.note: Claude 会用脚本运行两个税制并展示对比表。

say.text: 帮我核对 Form 16 和 AIS 里的 TDS。
say.note: Claude 会提取并验证 TDS 总额。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an ITR guide for FY 2025-26: gathers docs, validates data, runs scripted tax math (incl. regime comparison), outputs a filing pack, and directs portal steps. Scripts compute; you pay, submit, e-verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to file or verify taxes, compare regimes, or read Form 16/AIS docs — even just 'help me with my taxes'.

say_en.text: Help me file my income tax return for FY 2025-26.
say_en.note: Claude creates a workspace and starts gathering documents.

say_en.text: Compare old vs new regime for me.
say_en.note: Claude runs both regimes via script and shows the comparison.

say_en.text: Check TDS in my Form 16 and AIS.
say_en.note: Claude extracts and verifies TDS totals.
